headline: HuyenBao v11.44 — phục hồi thông báo cập nhật (per-patch + dynamic content từ version.json)
summary: UPDATE NOTIFICATION RESTORED. The what's-new modal stopped showing after v11.24 because the SEEN_KEY was per-major-version (tycoon_seen_v11) — once dismissed, no patch (v11.25-v11.43) ever re-triggered it. Fixed: SEEN_KEY is now per-patch (tycoon_seen_v11.44) so each new deployment re-shows the modal once. Content is now DYNAMIC — driven from /public/version.json's headline + features[] fields (which ARE updated per-patch), instead of the stale static V11_FEATURES list from v11.0. The modal fetches version.json on mount and renders the current patch's actual changelog. Old players who dismissed v11 will see this modal once on next load.
features: PER-PATCH SEEN_KEY: tycoon_seen_v11 → tycoon_seen_v11.44 (re-shows on each new patch)
DYNAMIC CONTENT: modal fetches /public/version.json headline + features[] on mount
REMOVED: stale static V11_FEATURES list (was from v11.0, never updated)
FALLBACK: if fetch fails, shows v11.headline + v11.summary i18n keys
Old players who dismissed v11 will see the modal once on next load
